note: Both sets extract a large number of claims, but both suffer from significant duplication (Set A repeats the rated torque four times, while Set B repeats the proportionality constant three times). Set B is slightly better because it successfully extracts properties of the various filters discussed in the text (Butterworth, Elliptic) and includes mechanical power and efficiency, whereas Set A has a malformed range claim (listing 871 rpm as the range rather than the upper bound). Both sets contain a typo in the unit for 99% ('99% %').
